Dialogue.Line: It's just an ordinary crate.
It doesn't look like it's been touched in a while.
The fountain has long since frozen over. Not even the faintest trickle of water remains.
The clock tower stands untouched beneath layers of snow.
None seems to have echoed through this place for a very long time.
...Hmm? Something wandered in. A wolf?
Oh! It seems to be injured...
Hang on... I'll help you.
You're awake...
Your wound isn't serious, but I don't have everything I need here.
I'll be right back to get some supplies to treat it.
Stay here, alright? Don't wander off.
Wait... where did the wolf go?
...You—were you the wolf from earlier?
That's impossible... but the wound... it's the same.
So you really are the same...
I've read about creatures that can change form, but I never thought I'd see one myself.
Don't worry. You're safe here. I won't tell anyone.
You look a little lost... Do you remember anything about where you came from?
…I see. Well, you’re currently in the Pale Snowfields. This place is known for its universities and research halls.
There are several regions beyond the snowfields.
To the south are the Springtide Meadows. It used to be a flourishing place where most of the food and crops were grown.
To the west lies the Mirage Plains, where craft guilds and smiths once forged tools, armor, and machinery.
And to the east is the Amberwood Forest, where trade routes and markets once connected people from different lands.
These places used to thrive… but things haven’t been the same for a long time.
There's an old legend everyone learns growing up….
If you're looking for answers, exploring the lands beyond the snowfields might help.
Take this map. It should help you find your way.
If you head south, you'll eventually reach the Springtide Meadows.
Obtained Map Item.
You should be on your way now, and make sure to take care, alright?
